title: Verb slot: verify
instructions: Choose the word-family form that makes the complete sentence grammatical and meaningful.

parts.prompt: Every team must ___ its measurements before adding them to the shared table.

choice_rationales.A: Verification is a noun, but the modal must requires a base verb next.
choice_rationales.B: Verifiable is an adjective and cannot follow must as the action.
choice_rationales.C: Verify is the base verb required after must and means check the measurements.
choice_rationales.D: Verifiably is an adverb and cannot supply the action after must.

parts.hint: A modal such as ‘must’ is followed by which verb form?
parts.correct_explanation: The modal frame ‘must verify’ requires the base form of the verb.
